name: nexora-arquitetura-claud
description: NEXORA Field Service ERP - Micro-Frontends Architecture (Host & Remote)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix remote" "npm run dev --prefix host"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix remote && npm run build --prefix host
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix remote && npm install --prefix host
scripts.services:dev: concurrently --kill-others -n os,tecnicos -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix os-service" "npm run dev --prefix tecnicos-service"
scripts.services:build: npm run build --prefix os-service && npm run build --prefix tecnicos-service
scripts.services:test: npm run test --prefix os-service && npm run test --prefix tecnicos-service
scripts.test:all: npm run services:test && npm run test:crud
